app.name: Tasheel Leasing
app.tagline: Digital leasing marketplace and financing intermediation

home.title: Finance your professional equipment, simply
home.subtitle: One file, several financial institutions, offers compared side by side.

business.title: Businesses
business.body: Find your equipment, send one file to several institutions and compare their offers.

supplier.title: Suppliers
supplier.body: Publish your catalogue and make financing a selling point on every item.

institution.title: Banks and leasing companies
institution.body: Receive complete files that match your criteria and manage your proposals online.

disclaimer.intermediary: Tasheel Leasing is a technology intermediation platform. It is neither a bank nor a leasing company. Financing decisions rest solely with the financial institutions.
disclaimer.indicative: Indicative estimate based on your assumptions. Only a proposal issued by a financial institution is an offer.

email.footer: Tasheel Leasing is a technology intermediation platform. It is neither a bank nor a leasing company.
email.ignore: If you did not make this request, you can ignore this message.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address — Tasheel Leasing
verify.body: To activate your account, please confirm your email address. This link is valid for {{hours}} hours.

reset.subject: Reset your password — Tasheel Leasing
reset.body: A password reset was requested for your account. This link is valid for {{minutes}} minutes and can be used once.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed — Tasheel Leasing
passwordChanged.body: Your account password was just changed and all your sessions were signed out. If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

invite.subject: {{organization}} invites you to Tasheel Leasing
invite.body: {{inviter}} invites you to join {{organization}} on Tasheel Leasing as "{{role}}". This invitation is valid for {{days}} days.

orgVerified.subject: Your organization is verified — Tasheel Leasing
orgVerified.body: {{organization}} has been verified by the Tasheel Leasing team. You now have access to all platform features.

orgRejected.subject: Verification of your organization — Tasheel Leasing
orgRejected.body: The verification of {{organization}} could not be completed. Reason: {{reason}}. You can complete your file and contact support.

orgSuspended.subject: Your organization is suspended — Tasheel Leasing
orgSuspended.body: Access for {{organization}} to Tasheel Leasing is suspended. Reason: {{reason}}. Contact support for more information.

quoteRequested.subject: New quotation request {{reference}} — Tasheel Leasing
quoteRequested.body: {{business}} requests a quotation for "{{listing}}" (quantity: {{quantity}}). Reply from your supplier area.

quoteIssued.subject: Quotation {{reference}} received — Tasheel Leasing
quoteIssued.body: {{supplier}} sent you a quotation for "{{listing}}": {{total}}, valid until {{validUntil}}.

documentRejected.subject: Document to replace: {{document}} — Tasheel Leasing
documentRejected.body: The document "{{document}}" could not be accepted. Reason: {{reason}}. Please upload a new version.

applicationReceived.subject: New financing application {{reference}} — Tasheel Leasing
applicationReceived.body: {{business}} sent you a financing application for {{amount}}. The file and its attachments are available in your area.

infoProvided.subject: Information received on {{reference}} — Tasheel Leasing
infoProvided.body: {{business}} replied to your request for information.

offerReceived.subject: Financing proposal for {{reference}} — Tasheel Leasing
offerReceived.body: {{institution}} sent you a proposal: {{installment}} per month over {{duration}} months. It remains subject to the institution’s final decision and contract.

applicationDeclined.subject: Answer from {{institution}} on {{reference}} — Tasheel Leasing
applicationDeclined.body: {{institution}} will not proceed with your application. Reason given: {{reason}}. Your other open applications are not affected.

offerAccepted.subject: Proposal accepted — {{reference}} — Tasheel Leasing
offerAccepted.body: {{business}} accepted your proposal. You can continue directly with the company for the final decision and contract.

applicationWithdrawn.subject: Application withdrawn — {{reference}} — Tasheel Leasing
applicationWithdrawn.body: {{business}} withdrew its financing application. The file and its documents are no longer accessible.

invoiceIssued.subject: Invoice {{number}} — Tasheel Leasing
invoiceIssued.body: Your commission invoice {{number}} is available: {{total}}, due by {{dueDate}}.

auth.mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
auth.mfaCodeHint: 6-digit code, or one of your recovery codes.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Register your organization on Tasheel Leasing.
register.consent: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy, and I authorize the processing of my organization's data.
register.verificationNotice: Your organization will be verified by the Tasheel team before it can use every feature.

reset.forgotSubtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
reset.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link valid for 30 minutes has just been sent.
reset.title: New password
reset.signOutNotice: You will be signed out on all your devices.
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.summary: You are invited to join this organization as "{{role}}" ({{email}}).
invite.wrongAccount: This invitation is addressed to {{email}}. Sign out and sign in with that account.
invite.signInFirst: An account already exists for this address. Sign in to accept the invitation.
invite.createAccount: Create your account to join the organization.

shell.mfaRequiredBody: It is mandatory for your organization. Other pages stay unavailable until it is on.
shell.emailUnverified: Confirm your email address with the link you received.
shell.pendingBody: The Tasheel team is reviewing your file. Complete the organization profile to speed it up.
shell.blockedBody: Access to features is blocked. Contact Tasheel support.
shell.noMembershipBody: Your account is not linked to any active organization. Ask an administrator for an invitation.

dashboard.stepProfile: Complete the organization profile (RC, NIF, wilaya, address)

org.title: Organization profile
org.identityLocked: Identity verified on {{date}}. To change it, contact Tasheel support.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Organization members and invitations.
team.inviteHint: The invitation is valid for 7 days. You can only assign roles whose permissions you all hold.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Protect access to your account.
security.requiredBody: Two-step verification is mandatory for your organization. Confirm your password to start.
security.optionalBody: Add a temporary code at each sign-in, generated by an app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
security.step1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (or enter the key manually).
security.step2: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app.
security.recoveryBody: Each code allows one sign-in if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
security.enabledBody: Two-step verification protects your account. To generate new recovery codes, enter a code from your app.

admin.documentsLater: Supporting documents are shown below, under "Verification papers".
admin.notifyNotice: The organization's administrators will be notified by email. The decision is recorded in the audit log.
admin.auditSubtitle: Every important action, across all organizations.

errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.INVALID_SESSION: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account already exists for this email address.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.MFA_REQUIRED_BY_POLICY: Two-step verification is mandatory for your organization.
errors.NOT_A_MEMBER: You do not have access to this organization.
errors.ORGANIZATION_BLOCKED: This organization is suspended or rejected.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.INVALID_INVITATION: This invitation is no longer valid.
errors.ACCOUNT_EXISTS: An account already exists for this address. Sign in to accept the invitation.
errors.INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation is addressed to a different email address.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member.
errors.ROLE_EXCEEDS_YOUR_PERMISSIONS: You cannot assign a role higher than your own.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: The organization must keep at least one administrator.
errors.CANNOT_MODIFY_SELF: You cannot change your own role or status.
errors.IDENTITY_LOCKED: A verified organization's identity is changed through support.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This action is not possible in the current status.
errors.CONCURRENT_CHANGE: The organization changed meanwhile. Reload the page.
errors.PLATFORM_IMMUTABLE: The Tasheel organization cannot be changed here.
errors.BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED: Fill in the billing settings first (issuer identity, VAT, payment terms, numbering).
errors.CUSTOMER_IDENTITY_INCOMPLETE: The customer organization has no commercial register number or NIF: complete its profile before issuing.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft can be issued or discarded.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_ISSUED: Only an issued invoice can be marked as paid.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_CREDITABLE: Only an issued or paid invoice can be cancelled with a credit note.
errors.INVALID_DATE: The payment date cannot be in the future.
errors.INVALID_PERIOD: The period must end today or earlier.
errors.INVALID_RANGE: The bounds are inconsistent (end before start, or maximum below minimum).
errors.INVALID_PAYER: This organization does not match the trigger (supplier or institution).
errors.NAME_REQUIRED: Give the rule a name in French or Arabic.
errors.RATE_REQUIRED: A percentage rule needs a rate.
errors.AMOUNT_REQUIRED: A fixed rule needs an amount.

market.title: Equipment marketplace
market.subtitle: Equipment from verified suppliers. Request a quotation in a few clicks.
market.signInToQuote: Sign in to request a quotation
market.businessOnly: Quotation requests are for business accounts.
market.verifiedOnly: Your organization must be verified before requesting a quotation.
market.shareNotice: The supplier will see your organization's name and yours.
market.quoteSentBody: Your request {{reference}} was sent to the supplier. Follow it in "My quotations".
market.financingHow: Need financing? Request a quotation; once accepted, you can submit it to partner financial institutions.

catalogue.title: My catalogue
catalogue.subtitle: Your equipment listings, from draft to publication.
catalogue.notVerifiedBody: You can prepare listings now; they can be published once your organization is verified.
catalogue.newSubtitle: Save a draft, then add photos and documents.
catalogue.titleHint: At least one title, in French or Arabic.
catalogue.priceHint: Indicative amount shown on the listing, up to 2 decimals.
catalogue.deliveryWilayasHint: Codes separated by commas (e.g. 16, 31). Empty = all.
catalogue.imagesHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB max. The first photo is the cover.
catalogue.documentsHint: Spec sheet or brochure as PDF, 15 MB max.
catalogue.filesAfterDraft: Photos and documents can be added once the draft is saved.

after.PENDING_REVIEW: Listing sent to Tasheel for review.

statusHelp.DRAFT: Visible to your organization only. Publish it when complete.
statusHelp.PENDING_REVIEW: Waiting for Tasheel review before publication.
statusHelp.PUBLISHED: Visible to everyone on the marketplace.
statusHelp.ARCHIVED: Removed from the marketplace. Existing quotations remain readable.
statusHelp.REJECTED: Fix the listing as indicated, then publish it again.

quotes.title: Quotations
quotes.subtitleSupplier: Requests from businesses and the quotations you issued.
quotes.subtitleBusiness: Your quotation requests and suppliers' proposals.
quotes.emptyBusiness: No requests yet. Find equipment on the
quotes.vatRateHint: The applicable rate is entered by you; Tasheel does not set it.
quotes.acceptedNext: Quotation accepted. You can now request financing based on it.

moderation.title: Listing moderation
moderation.subtitle: Review listings before publication and withdraw published ones.
moderation.settingOn: On: supplier listings are reviewed before publication.
moderation.settingOff: Off: verified suppliers publish directly. Tasheel can withdraw any listing at any time.
moderation.reasonHint: Required; recorded in the audit log.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Your organization’s document vault.
documents.fileHint: PDF, JPEG or PNG, 15 MB max. Every file is scanned by the antivirus.
documents.verificationHint: Requested by Tasheel to verify your organization.
documents.applicationHint: Attach them to any financing application. Institutions may ask for more.
documents.privacy: Your documents stay private. An institution only sees those you attach to an application you send it, and every download is logged.

financing.title: Financing applications
financing.subtitle: From an accepted quotation, approach the institutions you choose and compare their proposals.
financing.newSubtitle: The draft stays private until you choose the institutions.
financing.noAcceptedQuotation: You first need an accepted quotation. See your
financing.companyHint: Information you declare, shared with the institutions you approach.
financing.acceptedBody: The institution will contact you for its final decision and the contract. Tasheel takes no part in that decision.
financing.matchesDisclaimer: Indicative fit with each institution’s published criteria. It is neither eligibility nor a decision: only the institution decides.
financing.verifiedOnly: Your organization must be verified before sending.
financing.attachmentsHint: The institutions approached see only these documents. * = required.
financing.uploadNew: Upload and attach a new document
financing.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw the application? Institutions will lose access to the file.
financing.replyHint: To send a document, attach it to the application first.

offers.title: Proposals received
offers.disclaimer: Proposals from institutions, subject to their final decision and contract. Installments are computed from each institution’s terms.
offers.acceptBody: Other proposals will be declined and the other institutions informed. The chosen institution will contact you for its final decision and the contract.
offers.declineBody: The institution will be informed. Your application stays open with the others.

products.title: Financing products
products.subtitle: Your criteria and indicative rates, used for the indicative fit shown to businesses.
products.empty: No products. Businesses can only approach you through an active product.
products.wilayasHint: Codes separated by commas. Empty = all.
products.rateHint: Range shown to businesses as indicative. Your proposals set the actual terms.
products.requiredDocuments: Documents required in addition to the platform’s

inbox.title: Applications received
inbox.subtitle: Applications businesses chose to send you.

review.notice: Company information is declared by the business. Tasheel carries the file; the decision is yours.
review.downloadsAudited: Every download is recorded in your audit log.
review.declared: Data declared by the business when sending.
review.offerAdminOnly: Proposals are issued by an institution admin.
review.requestInfoHint: Say what you need. The business is notified by email.
review.declineHint: The reason is shared with the business. Any open proposal is withdrawn.
review.rateHint: Your terms. Tasheel sets no rate.
review.residualHint: Purchase option at the end (0 if none).
review.offerNotice: The installment and total cost are computed from your terms. The proposal remains subject to your final decision and contract.
review.acceptedBody: Continue directly with the business for your final decision and the contract.

adminDocs.title: Verification papers
adminDocs.empty: This organization has not uploaded any document.
adminDocs.rejectTitle: Ask for the document to be replaced
adminDocs.reasonHint: Required. Emailed and recorded in the audit log.
adminDocs.hint: The organization’s verification decision is still made with the buttons at the top.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: What happened on your files, across all your organizations.

reports.noActivity: No activity in this period yet.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Your commissions owed to Tasheel and your invoices.
billing.noRules: No commission rule applies to your organization.
billing.rulesHint: The commission terms that apply to your organization, as set by Tasheel.

rules.name: Rule
rules.empty: No rules. Without a rule, no commission is computed.
rules.precedence: On a given date, an organization-specific rule wins over the general one, then a category-limited rule, then the most recent.

triggerLabel.OFFER_ACCEPTED: Financing proposal accepted (paid by the institution)

adminBilling.title: Billing
adminBilling.subtitle: Commissions, invoices and credit notes issued by Tasheel.
adminBilling.generateHint: One draft per payer groups its uninvoiced commissions. Nothing is sent before issuing.
adminBilling.accrueHint: For deals accepted before a rule was created.
adminBilling.notConfigured: Billing is not configured yet: no invoice can be issued.
adminBilling.issuerHint: Legal mentions printed on each invoice, frozen on the invoice when it is issued.
adminBilling.vatHint: Applied to commissions when each invoice is issued.
adminBilling.numberingHint: Continuous numbering per year, given when issued (e.g. TSL-2026-000001). Invoices and credit notes share one sequence.
adminBilling.discardConfirm: Discard this draft? The commissions become available again.
adminBilling.issueConfirm: Issue the invoice? It gets a final number and can no longer be edited, only cancelled by a credit note.
adminBilling.draftNotice: Draft: identity, VAT and number are frozen when issued.
adminBilling.paymentReferenceHint: For example the transfer or cheque reference.
adminBilling.creditNoteTitle: Cancel the invoice with a credit note
adminBilling.creditNoteBody: A numbered credit note repeats every line negatively; the invoice becomes "cancelled". Nothing is deleted.
adminBilling.releaseHint: The commissions can be invoiced again (for example after a correction).
adminBilling.cancelHint: The commissions are cancelled and will not be invoiced.
